name: review-requests-changes
transcript:
Reviewing PR #503: adds a retry wrapper around the GitHub API calls.
Checked out the diff. Two problems:
1. The retry loop in src/gh_client.py catches a bare Exception, which would swallow CreditExhaustedError and burn the attempt budget against an exhausted billing signal.
2. The backoff timeout is hardcoded to 5 seconds instead of reading ci_poll_interval from config.
The happy path and the test coverage look good otherwise.
Posted a review requesting changes with both findings.
notes: Summary must capture the PR, the subject (retry wrapper), both concrete findings (swallowed credit error + hardcoded timeout), and the outcome (changes requested).
